verdict: Pitch Black has held its value better since release: PB26 64.74 (100 = Jul 2026) vs CR26 38.84 (100 = May 2026) at the Oct 5, 2026 mark (−35.3% in eleven weeks vs −61.2% in about four and a half months); latest week Sep 28→Oct 5 −5.0% vs −6.8%; since Aug 24 −21.4% vs −20.5% (seven weekly marks; that window still slightly favors CR). Weekly marks split 3–3; CR's two worst weeks are the last two. Pitch Black keeps the top single card (Mega Darkrai ex SIR $158.87, 30 sales Oct 6–10, vs Mega Greninja ex SIR $139.50, 30 sales Oct 5–10); top three $371.62 vs $315.49. Sealed entry asks are level on Oct 10 (ETB $69.95 vs $69.99, booster box $179.99 for both; 41 vs 5 boxes listed).
